About Peridot's body, I think it was a deliberate design instead of some horrible accident or incomplete development. If the majority of her body is prosthetic, and say only her head is a hard-light construct generated by her gem, then overall she'll be able to take quite a beating since there's only one major part of her body she has to worry about maintaining. The slinker could tear off all her limbs and she still wouldn't poof because you'd have to aim at her head. Then she'd be able to shapeshift into something small to evade further attacks and gather her parts to stick them back on.

The biggest disadvantage I see with this design is that the prosthetic limbs would probably interfere with shape-shifting. How would you incorporate two prosthetic legs meant for bipedal motion into the form of a volleyball? You'd either have to leave them somewhere, or encase them in your new hard light form.

The second biggest disadvantage I see with the design is that you could be effectively hobbled if you really did leave one of these parts behind. Unless she finds an effective replacement foot she'll either be hopping everywhere or flying. The flying might not be so bad, but it seems like she needs to use both her "hands" in order to steady her aim and shoot accurately. But she needs at least one free hand to fly, and on the ground standing on one leg can leave her defenseless (no strafing) and also impact her balance.
